name: Cheat Motion Crack Toss Perimeter Stretch

summary.motive: Weaponize extreme pre-snap speed ("Cheat Motion") to create an unmatchable angle on the perimeter, cracking the edge defender and pulling offensive linemen for an explosive outside toss.
summary.whyItWorks: The receiver hits the line of scrimmage at full sprint speed before the snap, allowing a 190-pound receiver to violently pin a 245-pound linebacker who cannot see the crack coming.
summary.failureMode: Field cornerback blowing up the crack block by shooting inside immediately or running back hesitating on the toss track rather than sprinting directly to the perimeter.

beats.title: 1. The Pre-Snap Cheat Motion Sprint
beats.text: Z (Tyreek Hill role) explodes in full-sprint cheat motion towards the tackle box before the snap. At the snap, he is already traveling at 18 mph with unstoppable downhill momentum.

beats.title: 2. The Devastating Crack-and-Pull
beats.text: Z delivers a crushing blindside crack block on the SAM linebacker, while the Right Tackle and Fullback pull violently around the perimeter to form a two-man escort wall.

beats.title: 3. Turning the Corner at Full Speed
beats.text: The running back receives the rapid toss while already at top speed, outflanking the defense and cutting off RT’s kick-out block on the field corner into open sideline grass.

beats.title: 4. 20+ MPH Boundary Explosion
beats.text: FB erases the strong safety in the alley while the running back accelerates past 21 mph down the sideline, leaving the free safety taking an impossible pursuit angle.

relations.tell: Receiver in cheat motion snaps inside to deliver crack block on edge/LB while RB takes immediate wide toss track.
